title: Prove two nodes share one mailbox

costar.context: The roadmap's build and one-node phases are done. two-node-shared was not_started, and shippin-cloud, the Zoho client, and the license choice depend on that proof or on a maintainer decision.
costar.objective: Observe the two-node exit proof: a message appended on one node is fetched from the other, with different node ids, FoundationDB, one S3 bucket, and NATS.
costar.style: One ignored integration test, a harness fix, and a roadmap status change.
costar.audience: The next coding agent and the maintainer.
costar.response: scale_two_nodes exits 0, two-node-shared is done, and organize.py --check exits 0.

concerns: The proof runs in WSL with libfdb_c.so and Docker. A native Windows cargo test --features scale is not this proof.
An unoptimized run overflowed the default worker stack. The passing command sets RUST_MIN_STACK=33554432.
minio/minio is gone from Docker Hub. The harness pulls cgr.dev/chainguard/minio, which answered /minio/health/live with the same server command.
FoundationDbStore::default() still has cluster_file null. Only the test store builder writes the container cluster file to the host.
The test crate did not compile until AssertResult was imported, the Keycloak realm path matched shippin-tech-realm.json, and itip_merge_changes received the iTIP calendar.
License choice, shippin.cloud hosting, and the Zoho client stay unstarted.
context: Two nodes must share FoundationDB, one S3 bucket, and NATS, while the default build stays rocks and enterprise. The ignored test scale_two_nodes is the exit proof.
current_state: scale_two_nodes passed in WSL. Node A appends scale-body-from-node-a over IMAP and node B fetches that body. The nodes lease different ids. The default Windows build of shippin-tech already exited 0.
target_design: The shared layout stays DataStore::FoundationDb, BlobStore::S3, and Coordinator::Nats. Rocks remains a default feature. Production cluster_file stays unset so compose can keep mounting /var/fdb. The test copies /var/fdb/fdb.cluster out of the FoundationDB container and passes that path in.
changes: tests/src/cluster/scale.rs imports AssertResult and records RUST_MIN_STACK=33554432 on the ignored test.
tests/src/utils/containers.rs copies the FoundationDB cluster file to the host, and pulls cgr.dev/chainguard/minio instead of minio/minio.
tests/src/utils/storage.rs passes that cluster file into FoundationDbStore when STORE=FoundationDb.
tests/src/webdav/cal_itip.rs passes the iTIP calendar into itip_merge_changes so the test crate compiles.
resources/scale/docker-compose.yml no longer says Dockerfile.fdb leaves enterprise off.
two-node-shared status in .ai/modules/roadmap/data/roadmap.json is done. .cursor/skills/roadmap is a junction to that folder.
boundaries: Do not change default features in crates/main/Cargo.toml.
Do not remove enterprise from either Dockerfile.
Do not use store::backend::composite or the sharded stores as the shared layout.
Do not choose a license, host shippin.cloud, or start the Zoho client.
Do not change production FoundationDbStore::default() cluster_file.
Do not open a GitHub issue or pull request.

verification.name: scale-two-nodes
verification.command: RUST_MIN_STACK=33554432 STORE=FoundationDb cargo test -p tests --features scale -- --ignored scale_two_nodes
verification.proves: A message appended on one node is fetched from the other node, and the two nodes leased different ids. A single fixture that never crosses nodes cannot pass this test.
verification.result: WSL Ubuntu, libfdb_c 7.4.8, Docker, CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0. test cluster::scale::scale_two_nodes ... ok. test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 96 filtered out; finished in 13.12s. EXIT=0.

verification.name: default-build-keeps-rocks-and-enterprise
verification.proves: The one-node build still finishes with the default features rocks and enterprise. The scale proof did not replace that build.
verification.result: Finished `dev` profile [unoptimized + debuginfo] target(s) in 32.73s. exit 0.
